constraints: The policy is answer blind and contains no patient identifiers or expected organisms.
Picked and Possible tiers remain unchanged; mandatory fallback is a reporting designation, not an increase in clinical certainty.
Only candidates with positive per-test reads and non-excluded QC may become primary candidates.
Reads are never summed across tests; only per-test rank and the strongest single-test signal are used as late tie-breakers.
Clinical pathogenic plausibility and specimen compatibility precede taxonomy confidence, reproducibility, within-test rank, and single-test reads.
Background viruses, colonizer-prone organisms, environmental organisms, and uncertain taxonomy are down-ranked but remain auditable.
Missing clinical evidence remains unknown rather than negative.
